note: Same study, second model: the 13 non-germ (somatic) cell types are told apart with macro AUC 0.999 on 2,827 held-out cells (hash model, 1,942 sequences; new screen 1 0.997; combined 0.999). Per type the AUC runs from 0.996 (stromal fgf24 cells) to 1.000 (theca cells and neutrophils). Liu et al. 2022 name 21 germ-cell genes; this model selected sequences of 4 of them. dmc1 has 9 sequences, all higher in early meiosis, the stage the paper marks with it. zp3a.1 has 5 sequences, all higher in the early egg stages. tmsb4x has 2 sequences; the paper reports it in stem cells, and its top sequence is higher in stem cells and progenitors. piwil1 has 5 sequences; the paper reports it in all germ cells. Not selected: nanos2, foxl2l, rec8a, zp3b, id4, ddx4 and 11 other named genes. Top sequence features: ranks 1 to 11, then zp2.2 (rank 27) and zp3a.1 (rank 43), named in the paper, and LOC101882393 (rank 23, second for stem cells and progenitors) and LOC137488332 (rank 49, first for late meiosis), shown on the card; other ranks are not shown. Rank = place among 525 named genes.
vc_note: Known variants: sequences that contain a known zebrafish dbSNP variant (Ensembl release 116, dbSNP build 150 on GRCz11, the only zebrafish variant source; ClinVar and COSMIC are human only). For this count the sequences were placed on GRCz11, not GRCz13ab. Splice junction (also on GRCz11): the sequence matches a spliced transcript of the same gene better than any single genome piece; junctions of other genes are not counted. One hmgb1a sequence with no genome placement is left out.
seq_note: Positions are on GRCz13ab (NCBI RefSeq); the known variant column uses the GRCz11 placement of the same sequence (zebrafish dbSNP is only on GRCz11). "matches genome" is the GRCz13ab placement.
